newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on the front page of its Wednesday edition:
- Bosnian municipal elections will be postponed for a second time because Bosnian Serbs are boycotting the vote.
- The U.S. Commerce Department has encountered anger among its trading partners regarding a new law that punishes foreign companies that do business in Cuba.
- The Pentagon will tell 20,000 veterans of the Persian Gulf War that they might have been exposed to nerve gas and blistering agents when U.S. engineers blew up an Iraqi ammunition depot.

- Republican campaign operatives are urging their party's congressional candidates to distance themselves from presidential candidate Bob Dole and are urging voters to maintain a Republican majority in the House of Representatives.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton is avoiding partisan politics in his campaign for re-election.
